gloss: on all fours; crawling on hands and knees

definitions.gloss: on all fours; crawling position; hands and knees
definitions.explanation: The posture of being down on both hands and both knees, like a crawling baby or an animal. Used to describe the physical position itself.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{四|よ}つん{這|ば}いで{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: The baby is crawling on all fours.

examples.japanese: {四|よ}つん{這|ば}いになって、ベッドの{下|した}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I got on all fours and looked under the bed.

examples.japanese: {暗|くら}いトンネルの{中|なか}は{天井|てんじょう}が{低|ひく}くて、{四|よ}つん{這|ば}いでしか{進|すす}めなかった。
examples.english: The ceiling inside the dark tunnel was so low that we could only move forward on all fours.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the pattern {四|よ}つん{這|ば}いになる (to get on all fours). The word comes from {四|よ}つ (four) and {這|は}い (crawling). A simple, descriptive word for a physical posture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四|よ}つん{這|ば}いになる (to get on all fours)
- {四|よ}つん{這|ば}いで{進|すす}む (to move forward on all fours)
- {四|よ}つん{這|ば}いの{姿勢|しせい} (all-fours posture)
